# Search and vector indexes — vocabulary

## Terms

- **index** · self — MongoDB Search Indexes are a specific type of index supported for search queries within Atlas. · aka: indexes, indices, indexing, indexed — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/llms.txt
- **compound index** · hyponym · aka: compound indexes, composite index, composite indexes, multi-column index, multicolumn index · MongoDB 'compound' = SQL 'composite'/'multicolumn'
- **unique index** · hyponym · aka: unique indexes, uniqueIndex
- **partial index** · hyponym · aka: partial indexes, filtered index, partialIndexes
- **B-tree** · hyponym · aka: btree, B+tree, b-tree index, B-tree indexes

- **GiST index** · hyponym · aka: GiST, SP-GiST, GiST indexes, btree_gist · Postgres
- **BRIN index** · hyponym · aka: BRIN, block range index, BRIN indexes · Postgres
- **hashed index** · hyponym · aka: hashed indexes, hash index, hash indexes, $toHashedIndexKey
- **text index** · hyponym — Version 3 text indexes are the current standard, supporting multiple languages via the `default_language` option. · aka: text indexes, full-text index, search index, search indexes, withSearchIndex, tsvector, pg_trgm · full-text/search indexes (Atlas Search, Convex search index, Postgres FTS) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/manual-1-llms.txt
- **vector index** · hyponym · aka: vector indexes, HNSW, IVFFlat, DiskANN, vectorIndex, approximate nearest neighbor · pgvector / Atlas Vector Search / Convex vector index — an index type, not the Pinecone sense
- **multikey index** · hyponym · aka: multikey, multikey indexes
- **TTL index** · hyponym · aka: TTL indexes, expireAfterSeconds
- **wildcard index** · hyponym · aka: wildcard indexes
- **geospatial index** · hyponym · aka: geospatial indexes, 2dsphere, 2d index
- **clustered index** · hyponym · aka: clustered indexes, clustered collection, WITHOUT ROWID
- **expression index** · hyponym · aka: expression indexes, functional index, index on an expression
- **sparse index** · hyponym · aka: sparse indexes
- **hidden index** · hyponym · aka: hidden indexes, hideIndex, unhideIndex
- **index definition** · part · aka: index name, index fields, index key, index keys, key pattern, index entry, index entries, index bounds, index specification, IndexFields, IndexName
- **index prefix** · part · aka: index prefixes, leftmost prefix, left-most prefix, prefix of the index, leading column
- **covered query** · dependent · aka: covered queries, covering index, covering indexes, index-only scan, index only scan, covered by an index, cover multiple queries
- **ESR rule** · dependent · aka: ESR guideline, ESR, equality sort range, Equality, Sort, Range
- **index build** · dependent · aka: index builds, CREATE INDEX, createIndex, createIndexes, DROP INDEX, dropIndex, dropIndexes, CONCURRENTLY, index creation, create an index, add an index, drop an index, rolling index build, staged index, getIndexes, listIndexes, index backfill
- **@@index** · instance · aka: @@unique · Prisma schema index attributes
- **withIndex** · instance · aka: IndexRangeBuilder, index range, range expression, .index(, IndexRange, LowerBoundIndexRangeBuilder · Convex index API
- **selectivity** · measure · aka: selective, cardinality, high-cardinality, planner statistics, sqlite_stat1, n_distinct, pg_stats
- **totalKeysExamined** · measure · aka: totalDocsExamined, keysExamined, docsExamined, nReturned, executionStats, executionTimeMillis
